description: Injury/Illness Summary - Casualty Data (Form 55a) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by FRA Safe Team. Casualties are reportable fatalities, injuries, or illnesses arising from the operation of a railroad. Casualties may be classified as either fatal or nonfatal. All casualty incidents are reported to the FRA on Form FRA F 6180.55a Injury/Illness Continuation Sheet. This dataset is in a user-friendly human-readable format. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 72 columns, among them Incident Key, Geocode, Reporting Railroad Holding Company, Reporting Parent Railroad Name, Reporting Parent Railroad Code, Reporting Railroad SMT Grouping. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last data update. Attribution given: FRA Safe Team. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
